class.name: DrawDebug
class.brief_description: Immediate-mode debug drawing of lines, shapes and text, similar to the DrawDebug helpers of Unreal Engine.
class.description: Singleton for quick visual debugging in 3D. Call its methods from anywhere (including [method Node._process], [method Node._physics_process], [code]@tool[/code] scripts and other threads): [codeblock] func _physics_process(delta): DrawDebug.sphere(global_position, 0.5, Color.GREEN) DrawDebug.arrow(global_position, global_position + velocity, Color.YELLOW) DrawDebug.text(global_position + Vector3.UP, "speed: %.1f" % velocity.length()) [/codeblock] The lifetime of every primitive is controlled by its [code]duration[/code] argument: [code]0.0[/code] draws it for one frame (when called from a physics tick, until the next physics tick, so it does not flicker), a positive value draws it for that many seconds of real time, and a negative value keeps it until [method clear] or [method clear_persistent] is called. When [code]depth_test[/code] is [code]false[/code], the primitive is drawn on top of all geometry. All primitives are batched into four meshes (lines and triangles, depth-tested and on top) owned directly by the [RenderingServer]. Their vertex buffers work as a pool: they are updated in place every frame, grow to the next power of two when needed and shrink back after a long period of low usage, so drawing thousands of shapes every frame does not allocate nodes, resources or GPU buffers. Drawing is enabled by default in debug builds and the editor. In release builds it is disabled unless [member ProjectSettings.debug/draw_debug/enabled_in_release_builds] is set; calls then do nothing. [b]Note:[/b] Lines are always 1 pixel wide. Text is drawn as a 2D overlay of the main viewport (or the 3D editor viewports in the editor).

method.name: aabb
method.description: Draws the wireframe of an [AABB].

method.name: arrow
method.description: Draws a line from [param from] to [param to] with an arrow head at [param to]. If [param head_size] is [code]0.0[/code] or less, it is 20% of the arrow length.

method.name: box
method.description: Draws an axis-aligned wireframe box at [param center] with the given [param half_extents].

method.name: box_oriented
method.description: Draws a wireframe box with the given [param half_extents], positioned, rotated and scaled by [param transform].

method.name: camera_frustum
method.description: Draws the view frustum of a [Camera3D] that is inside the scene tree.

method.name: capsule
method.description: Draws a wireframe capsule whose hemisphere centers are [param from] and [param to].

method.name: circle
method.description: Draws a circle around [param center] in the plane perpendicular to [param normal].

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes every primitive, text and message, including persistent and timed ones.

method.name: clear_persistent
method.description: Removes all persistent primitives, texts and messages (drawn with a negative [code]duration[/code]).

method.name: cone
method.description: Draws a wireframe cone from [param apex] along [param direction]. [param angle] is the half-angle of the cone in radians.

method.name: coordinate_system
method.description: Draws the X (red), Y (green) and Z (blue) axes of [param transform], [param scale] units long (multiplied by the basis scale).

method.name: crosshair
method.description: Draws three axis-aligned lines crossing at [param position], [param size] units long.

method.name: cylinder
method.description: Draws a wireframe cylinder between the centers of its caps [param from] and [param to].

method.name: frustum
method.description: Draws a frustum described by [param projection], placed in the world with [param transform] (for a camera: its global transform).

method.name: grid
method.description: Draws a square grid of [param cells] by [param cells] cells in the XZ plane of [param transform], centered on its origin.

method.name: line
method.description: Draws a line between [param from] and [param to].

method.name: lines
method.description: Draws independent line segments: each pair of consecutive points in [param points] is one segment.

method.name: mesh
method.description: Draws the triangle edges of [param mesh] transformed by [param transform].

method.name: message
method.description: Shows an on-screen text message in the top-left corner for [param duration] seconds (negative: until cleared, [code]0.0[/code]: one frame). If [param key] is [code]0[/code] or greater, a previous message with the same key is replaced instead of adding a new line, which is useful for values updated every frame.

method.name: plane
method.description: Draws a square of [param size] units on [param plane], centered on the projection of [param center] onto it, with an arrow showing the plane normal.

method.name: point
method.description: Draws a point as a small solid cube of [param size] units.

method.name: polyline
method.description: Draws a line strip through [param points]. If [param closed] is [code]true[/code], the last point is connected to the first.

method.name: ray
method.description: Draws a line from [param origin] to [code]origin + direction[/code].

method.name: solid_aabb
method.description: Draws a filled [AABB].

method.name: solid_box
method.description: Draws a filled axis-aligned box at [param center] with the given [param half_extents].

method.name: solid_box_oriented
method.description: Draws a filled box with the given [param half_extents], positioned, rotated and scaled by [param transform].

method.name: solid_circle
method.description: Draws a filled disc around [param center] in the plane perpendicular to [param normal].

method.name: solid_mesh
method.description: Draws the triangles of [param mesh] transformed by [param transform] in a single color.

method.name: solid_plane
method.description: Draws a filled square of [param size] units on [param plane], centered on the projection of [param center] onto it.

method.name: solid_sphere
method.description: Draws a filled sphere.

method.name: solid_triangle
method.description: Draws a filled triangle.

method.name: sphere
method.description: Draws a wireframe sphere made of latitude and longitude lines. [param segments] is the number of longitude segments.

method.name: text
method.description: Draws [param text] centered at the screen projection of [param position]. Text behind the camera is not drawn.

members.member: If [code]false[/code], all drawing calls are ignored and everything currently drawn is cleared.
